title: Chapter 14: Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubayr (64–73 AH / 683–692 CE) — introduction
headingUrdu: چودھواں باب: حضرت عبد اللہ بن زبیر (64ھ تا 73ھ بمطابق 683ء تا 692ء) — تعارف
headingPashto: څوارلسم باب: حضرت عبدالله بن زبیر (۶۴ تر ۷۳ هـ د ۶۸۳ تر ۶۹۲ ز) — پېژندنه

paras.ur: حضرت عبد اللہ بن زبیر رضی اللہ عنہ
paras.ps: حضرت عبدالله بن زبیر رضی الله عنه

paras.en: (64 AH to 73 AH, corresponding to 683 CE to 692 CE)
paras.ps: (۶۴ تر ۷۳ هجري د ۶۸۳ تر ۶۹۲ زېږدیز سره سم)

paras.en: Introduction: Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubayr was the son of Hazrat Zubayr bin al-Awwam. Hazrat Aisha Siddiqah was his maternal aunt. He was good, God-fearing and pious. In the period of rule of Hazrat Amir Mu’awiyah he took part in several battles. In the attack on Constantinople he was at the front. When Hazrat Amir Mu’awiyah began the series of pledges for Yazid, he took permission from the governor of Madinah and went to Makkah. After the incident of Karbala he announced the caliphate. When Yazid learnt of the announcement of Abdullah bin Zubayr he sent Muslim bin Uqbah with an army of ten thousand. For three days a bloody battle took place in Madinah. Fadl bin Abbas, Abdullah bin Hanzalah, Abdullah bin Muti’ and several other chiefs were killed; the Syrian armies went on plundering the settlement of the Holy Prophet for three days. After this Muslim bin Uqbah set out for Makkah but died on the way. Madinah was ruined. Husayn ended the siege of the Ka’bah and began talks with Abdullah bin Zubayr.
